title: Yoh! Bestie
overview: Thando is perpetually unlucky in love, but when her bestie returns from his travels with a fiancée in tow, she's forced to face a new emotion — jealousy.

title: The Roaring Game
overview: High school janitor Rickey loses everything when his girlfriend, Kelly, is selected to play hockey for Team USA and compete in the World Games. To win her back, Rickey creates a misfit curling team and uses his sweeping skills to compete for gold and complete a comic quest for redemption that captivates the nation.

title: Coexistence, My Ass!
overview: Noam Shuster Eliassi grew up the literal poster child for the Israeli-Palestinian peace process before making a hard pivot to stand-up comedy and political satire. But as the region sinks deeper into devastating violence, she must meet the moment by challenging her audiences with hard truths that are no laughing matter.

title: Rivals: The 4 Nations Face-Off
overview: In early February 2025, the world’s top hockey nations, including Canada, Finland, Sweden and the U.S., came together to pit their best players  against each other in the 4 Nations Face-Off. The tournament replaced the NHL’s annual All-Star game and offered a chance for players to wear their national colours and assert their hockey dominance.  None more so than Canada and the U.S. For decades, each team has staked a claim as “world’s best,” but as the first puck dropped, things were more heated than normal.

title: Gerta Schnirch
overview: Gerta grows up in 1930s Brno in a mixed Czech-German family, which brings her into conflict with her father as he embraces Nazi ideology. Despite this, they remain connected through their shared love of music. During the occupation, Gerta joins the student resistance with her beloved Karel, but the war takes everything from her and leaves her with a dark secret that shapes her future.  After the war, though innocent, Gerta is violently forced into the wild expulsion and must leave her hometown with her infant daughter. She survives the hardest years on a rural farm, reunites with Karel, and returns to Brno hoping for a normal life—yet the past continues to haunt her.  The two-part TV film Gerta Schnirch offers a personal view of 20th-century history through the fate of a woman caught between two worlds.

title: Unintended Consequences
overview: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother's honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

title: Geomancer
overview: When a border village is destroyed and its people turned into shadow soldiers, reclusive prodigy Bai Yinchuan must navigate deadly conspiracies and supernatural forces to uncover the truth. Amid betrayal and sacrifice, he learns that real power lies not in mystic arts or imperial authority, but in the hearts of the people.

title: Attack of the Kraken
overview: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.

title: Abel Ernest Tembo's Suspect
overview: Inspector Joseph Kimball Kobé and his team investigate a mysterious cult of serial killers calling themselves "the lost souls." They are determined to save the world from this threat.

title: meppets
overview: who will i meep next?  12 months of puppet making condensed into a single film.

title: SMTOWN LIVE 2025-26 in FUKUOKA
overview: 2025 marks SM Entertainment's 30th anniversary, celebrated with performances around the world.  Now, SM artists are gathering in Fukuoka!  They'll ignite Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka with powerful performances filled with love for all fans.  Experience the spectacular live show featuring SM Entertainment artists all together in one place, live and in real time. The lineup of artists includes TVXQ, SUPER JUNIOR,  HYOYEON (Girls’ Generation), MINHO (SHINee), EXO, Red Velvet (IRENE & SEULGI & JOY), NCT 127,  aespa, NCT DREAM, WayV, RIIZE, NCT WISH, Hearts2Hearts, and XngHan&Xoul.

title: The Gayma Wards
overview: While hosting a parody awards show, everything starts to go wrong. Presenters are sabotaging, guests aren't showing up and the host is at their wits end.

title: Misery Signals: The Final Performance
overview: The Final Live performance from Misery Signals, recorded at Union Hall, Edmonton 10.19.24

title: Andre
overview: Andre inherits a small fortune, which pushes him into a series of surreal and aimless encounters with eccentric strangers.

title: A Year in The Life at MKBHD.
overview: We recorded... everything

title: Tape Me
overview: Watch Me, Torture Me, Tape Me, follow Faceless as he catalogues his stalking, kidnapping and torturing of his victims. His victims range from privileged socialites and the financially desperate promised salvation through a deadly game.

title: Terri Joe: Missionary in Miami
overview: In this wild farce, Southern Belle Terri Joe ventures to Miami to outrun wacky criminals and find a new church where she can atone for her sins.

title: Four For One
overview: In this one-day dark comedy, an office worker hires assassins to get revenge after a co-worker steals credit for his promotion. Panicked, the credit thief hires private security, and the escalating paranoia is told from multiple perspectives-assassins, guards, and office staff-all racing toward an absurd final showdown over the pettiest feud imaginable.

title: Six String Sky
overview: As family pressures and authority figures try to shut them down, two high school friends fight for one shot to share their voices and pursue their dreams of becoming musicians.

title: Western Simulacrum
overview: Inspired by the writings of Jean Baudrillard, this film - shot entirely within the videogame Red Dead Redemption 2 - examines people's perception of history, in this case the Wild West period, and how it has been influenced by media representation and recreation, or perhaps how it has been entirely replaced by it.
